verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced inside Airwallex itself. AgentOS and its MCP server, CLI and skills let external agents such as Claude Code or Cursor read data and build cashflow reports, but that analysis happens in third-party agents, which is adjacent tooling rather than an in-product insights feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
